import {copyPreviewHostAssets,copyRuntimeAssets,readPreviewHostHostingContract} from '@tanstack/browser-sandbox-experimental/assets'
import type {PreviewHostHostingContract,PreviewHostRoute} from '@tanstack/browser-sandbox-experimental/assets'

const path:string=copyRuntimeAssets('/tmp/my-app/public/runtime')
path.toUpperCase()
const copy:(destination:string)=>string=copyRuntimeAssets
void copy
const previewPath:string=copyPreviewHostAssets('/tmp/my-app/public/preview')
previewPath.toUpperCase()
const hosting:PreviewHostHostingContract=readPreviewHostHostingContract()
const route:PreviewHostRoute=hosting.routes[0]!
const method:'GET'=route.method
const fallback:503=hosting.fallbackStatus
void method;void fallback
// @ts-expect-error destination is a path string, not a configuration object
copyRuntimeAssets({destination:'/tmp/runtime'})
// @ts-expect-error destination is required
copyRuntimeAssets()
// @ts-expect-error the copy helper is synchronous, not a promise
const pending:Promise<string>=copyRuntimeAssets('/tmp/runtime')
// @ts-expect-error preview destination is required
copyPreviewHostAssets()
// @ts-expect-error verified contract fields are immutable
hosting.scope='/app/'
